# Ibanora

> Multi-currency accounts in EUR, USD and GBP, cross-border payments, stablecoin and crypto wallets, and on-ramp and off-ramp, with payments routed through stablecoins. Ibanora is a technology brand, not a bank; services are provided through partner Mosta Payments Ltd.

## Pages

- [Multi-currency account with stablecoin wallets | Ibanora](https://ibanora.com/): Open a multi-currency account for EUR, USD and GBP, make cross-border payments and hold stablecoins in a wallet next to it. Sign up online or talk to us.
- [Multi-currency business account for EUR, USD, GBP | Ibanora](https://ibanora.com/accounts/business/): A multi-currency business account to collect from customers, pay suppliers and teams abroad, and hold EUR, USD, GBP and more. Sign up or talk to our team.
- [Euro account: hold, send and receive euros | Ibanora](https://ibanora.com/accounts/eur/): Looking for a euro bank account? An Ibanora euro account lets you hold, convert, send and receive EUR next to USD and GBP. Sign up online or talk to us.
- [GBP account: hold, send and receive pounds | Ibanora](https://ibanora.com/accounts/gbp/): Hold, convert, send and receive pounds sterling with an Ibanora GBP account, next to your EUR and USD balances. Sign up online or talk to our team first.
- [Personal multi-currency account for EUR, USD, GBP | Ibanora](https://ibanora.com/accounts/personal/): Open a personal multi-currency account to hold, convert and send EUR, USD, GBP and more, with transfers routed through stablecoins. Sign up online today.

- [Wise alternatives in 2026: how the options compare | Ibanora](https://ibanora.com/blog/wise-alternatives/): Looking for a Wise alternative? Compare fees, currencies, business tools and crypto access at Revolut, Payoneer, Airwallex, OFX and a bank, as of November 2026.
